versions.changelog:
- Initial release of clinical teaching case generation skill.
- Generates teaching cases based on key points provided in question text or structured input.
- Supports flexible input methods: direct question string, input file (`.json`, `.jsonl`, plain text), or standard input.
- Utilizes internal medical LLM (`u1-insuremed`) via configurable API.
- Includes options for input selection, model parameters, and dry-run mode.
- Outputs structured JSON with answer, input details, and metadata.
- Emphasizes de-identification and compliance with patient data protocols.
